This master services agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of 12.01.2026 (the "Effective Date") by and between Zürichsee
Handels AG, with its registered office at Bahnhofstrasse 12, Basel ("Party A"), and Helvetia Präzision AG, with its registered office at
Bahnhofstrasse 12, Genève ("Party B").

1. Term

This Agreement shall remain in force for a period of 36 months from the Effective Date unless terminated earlier in accordance with
Section 7.

2. Confidentiality

Each party shall keep confidential all non-public information received from the other party and shall use it solely for the purposes of this
Agreement.

3. Governing Law

This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of England and Wales.
